question: Who among the following founded the Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (Majoor Mahajan Sangh), India's oldest union of textile workers, in 1920?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anasuya Sarabhai.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The founder of **Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association **(Majoor Mahajan Sangh) was Anasuya Sarabhai, who founded the union in** 1920.**
 
• Anasuya Sarabhai was a **social worker**, and a pioneer in the **labour movement** in India.
 
• She was also the **first woman **to run for the post of the **President **of the **Indian National Congress in 1921.**
 
• The Ahmedabad Textile Labour Association (Majoor Mahajan Sangh) is India's **oldest union of textile workers** and has played a significant role in improving the **working conditions** and **wages of textile workers** in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poornima Arvind Pakvasa **was an Indian social worker and politician, who played a crucial role in the **upliftment of women and children** in Gujarat.

 
 
• She received the** Padma Bhushan award** in** 2004** in recognition of her contributions to society.
 
 
 
• **Hansa Jivraj Mehta** was a prominent **social worker, feminist, and writer** from Gujarat, who worked towards the betterment of women's rights and education.
 
 
• In** 1959**, Hansa Mehta received the **Padma Bhushan.**
 
 
 
• **Indumati Chamamlal **was an **Indian social worker and politician,** who was associated with the Indian National Congress and played an active role in the Indian independence movement.
 
 
• She held the positions of **Gujarat's education minister **and **Bombay State's deputy minister of education**.
